entries.summary: K8 exports ./l-test-host (src/l-test-host.test-support.ts), an L test Host built only from the published packages: an embedded SQLite server, a paired daemon with a stub runtime that submits the result document, and the HostLedger. The K8 routine and delivery vectors run on it instead of the K4 openHost, so a Host that vendors K8 can run them too (#1325). The test Host changes no K8 rule; a Host that vendored K8 copies the new file with the two contract tests, as src/VENDOR.md Layer 3 lists. K8 also lets an external team snapshot mark a Bot participation: 'suspended' (#1319): the Bot stays in the team but takes no new work, its open work ends as for an archived Bot (delegation reason target_suspended, undelivered initiator_suspended), and input, answer and decide for it refuse with TeamModeError code bot_suspended. A later snapshot without the field restores it; a snapshot without the field behaves as before (README.md#external-team-authority). K8 also adds BotCollaboration.setModels(models) (#1357): construction and setModels re-project the Host's model templates onto every unarchived Bot by model name, keeping its device and profile; a frozen Turn keeps its execution. A missing template of an existing Bot no longer refuses a snapshot, update_bot, construction or setModels: each of the Bot's Turns blocks with Unavailable model: <name> before it freezes, in K8 and H, until the template returns (README.md#group-chat-and-main-bot). A Host that vendored K8 copies the changed src/rules files.
